core_obligations: Implement degree-peeling with exponentially separated safety buckets and local update thresholds.
Bound communication per vertex over all bucket changes and recover the exact degeneracy, an ordering and a core.
difficulty_reason: The authors turn graph peeling into a communication protocol using exponentially spaced safe degree classes and updates triggered by local degree decreases, with an amortized logarithmic number of updates per vertex.
